finding.claim: Default LZ4BlockInputStream constructors pass attacker-supplied block bytes to the JNI LZ4_decompress_fast, which is not safe for untrusted input and can read/write out of bounds in native memory.
finding.source: Bytes of any stream wrapped by new LZ4BlockInputStream(in) or new LZ4BlockInputStream(in, stopOnEmptyBlock), e.g. network or file input. Requires the native library to load (default with system class loader).
finding.sink: fastDecompressor.decompress(compressedBuffer, 0, buffer, 0, originalLen) at LZ4BlockInputStream.java:322, which calls LZ4_decompress_fast in src/jni/net_jpountz_lz4_LZ4JNI.c:233 with no source-length argument.

trace.note: fastestInstance() returns nativeInstance() when Native.isLoaded() or system class loader
LZ4_decompress_fast(in+srcOff, out+destOff, destLen) on attacker bytes
Attacker payload read into compressedBuffer (may be larger than compressedLen due to reuse)
Fast decompress with no source length; output bounded only by originalLen

finding.guards_checked: Magic and method byte check (268-278); originalLen bounded by 1<<compressionLevel and non-negative (283-284); compressedLen non-negative (285); LZ4 compressedLen < originalLen unless acceptOversizedBlocks (289); checksum verified only after decompression (334-337), so ineffective as a pre-decompression guard. Not a control: LZ4Factory.java:104-112 documents the JNI fast decompressor as insecure for untrusted input and it is deprecated for that use; the default constructors do not avoid it. Unverified: the C body of LZ4_decompress_fast is not in this checkout, so the memory-safety impact rests on the library's own documentation. No reproducer was built.

finding.claim: With acceptOversizedBlocks enabled, an attacker-controlled 4-byte compressedLen in a block header drives an allocation of up to about 2 GiB before any payload is read, enabling memory-exhaustion DoS.
finding.source: compressedLen (int, little-endian) from block header bytes MAGIC_LENGTH+1..+4 at LZ4BlockInputStream.java:279, from any untrusted stream. Requires the caller to opt in via the builder's acceptOversizedBlocks option.
finding.sink: compressedBuffer = new byte[Math.max(compressedLen, compressedBuffer.length * 3 / 2)] at LZ4BlockInputStream.java:311-312.

trace.note: compressedLen >= originalLen check is skipped when acceptOversizedBlocks is true

finding.guards_checked: Default configuration is bounded: LZ4 blocks require compressedLen < originalLen (289) and RAW blocks require compressedLen == originalLen (288), so the allocation is at most 32 MiB. Only the acceptOversizedBlocks opt-in removes the bound. Low severity; reported as a conditional candidate.
